namaBarang: Ashless Filter Paper for Quantitative Analysis
type: Ashless Filter Paper for Quantitative Analysis
description:
These CHM® filter papers are used for quantitative analysis and designed for preparation of samples and gravimetric analysis. They are made of refined pulp and linters with virtually 100% of alpha-cellulose content. Extremely low percentage of ash content (maximum ash content of <0.007%).

Grades

  • F2045 GRADE: Very fast filtration. Wide-pored, soft, spongy structure.
  • F2041 GRADE: Fast filtration. Suitable for analytical procedures and tests involving large particles.
  • F2043 GRADE: Medium filtration. Good retention of medium and thick particles.
  • F2040 GRADE: Medium-slow filtration. Classic general purpose ashless filter paper.
  • F2044 GRADE: Slow filtration. Thinner version of F2042 Grade with a higher flow rate.
  • F2042 GRADE: Very slow filtration. Ashless world standard filter for critical gravimetric analysis.

namaBarang: Ashless Hardened Filter Paper for Quantitative Analysis
type: Ashless Hardened Filter Paper for Quantitative Analysis
description:
Ashless hardened Filter papers are acid hardened which reduce the ash content to an extremely low level. A maximum ash content of <0.006% is attained, which means that no contaminants are introduced when filtering. Thanks to the hardened texture, they are often used when the analyst must recover the precipitates retained on the filter surface.

Grades

  • F2141 GRADE: Fast filtration. Preferably used for the filtration of coarse flocculent and bulky precipitates.
  • F2140 GRADE: Medium filtration. Extremely strong and pure. Recommended for filtering medium-sized precipitates.
  • F2142 GRADE: Slow filtration. High retention and slow flow rate. High chemical resistance.

namaBarang: Hardened Low Ash Filter Paper for Quantitative Analysis
type: Hardened Low Ash Filter Paper for Quantitative Analysis
description:
These filters, made from cotton linters fiber, are put through a washing process and treated with strong acids. A very low ash-content filter with a <0.015% (intermediate between CHM® qualitative grades and ashless quantitative grades).

Grades

  • F2054 GRADE: Fast filtration. The fastest filter paper in the range.
  • F2052 GRADE: Medium-fast filtration. General-purpose hardened filter paper with medium-rate filtering.
  • F2050 GRADE: Slow filtration. Excellent retention of very fine particles.

namaBarang: Ashless Hardened Filter Paper for Qualitative Analysis
type: Ashless Hardened Filter Paper for Qualitative Analysis
description:
These filter papers are used for qualitative analysis. Qualitative filters are made of refined pulp and pure cotton linters with an alpha-cellulose content of nearly 100%. The ash content of less than 0,06% is not reduced by post-treatment.

Grades

  • F1004 GRADE: Very fast filtration.
  • F1007 GRADE: Fast filtration.
  • F1001 GRADE: Medium filtration. The most widely used filter paper in the CHM® range.
  • F1002 GRADE: Medium-slow filtration.
  • F1003 GRADE: Medium-slow filtration (thick).
  • F1006 GRADE: Slow filtration.
  • F1005 GRADE: Very slow filtration.
